finding: A material-only candidate can be proven independent from mesh/rig changes only when structure, UVs, weights, actions, packed images and material identity are fingerprinted separately.
guidance: Clone the inherited material, retain base-color and normal-map links, change only named scalar shader controls, and render the same turntable under the same lighting. Require a preservation report before evaluating the look. Do not treat a material study as approval of unresolved topology, animation, LOD or target-runtime issues.
